title: Near-Degenerate Reversible 1:2 Resonance and Sextic Crossover in a (2, 3, 5, 7) Carnot Geodesic Flow
description: Preprint and reproducibility package for a near-degenerate reversible 1:2 resonance in a reduced (2,3,5,7) Carnot geodesic flow. The work identifies quartic near-degeneracy, sextic promotion, two periodic-orbit action scales, a quartic-sextic crossover, and residual elliptic period-two cycles, supported by exact-return and multiprecision audits.
